note: Stored conversation records readable by precedent_finder. age_days is an offset from the current date so the 90-day retention window stays meaningful over time instead of ageing out of a hard-coded fixture. Records that are not approved, or whose age_days exceeds retention_days, exist here precisely so the filters in agent_runtime are exercised - they must never reach a reply.

conversations.title: Customer cannot complete a password reset
conversations.answer: The reset link is valid for 60 minutes and can only be used once. Ask the customer to request a fresh link from the Forgot password option on the sign-in screen and to open it in the same browser, then choose a new password of at least 12 characters.

conversations.title: Password reset email never arrives
conversations.answer: If the reset email has not arrived after 10 minutes, have the customer check the spam folder and confirm the address on the account. If the address is wrong, the account-recovery path has to verify a new address before any reset link will help.

conversations.title: Where do I find my invoices
conversations.answer: Invoices live under Billing > Invoices in account settings, with a PDF link for each of the last 24 billing periods. The tab is only visible to account owners and users with the billing role.

conversations.title: Requesting a full account data export
conversations.answer: Only the account owner can request an export, from Settings > Data. Large accounts can take up to 24 hours, and the download link in the notification expires after 7 days.

conversations.title: Which browsers are supported
conversations.answer: The two most recent major versions of Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari are supported, with JavaScript and cookies enabled. Internet Explorer is not supported.
